scripts.name: Volume-Weighted Order Block Zones [BigBeluga]
scripts.author: BigBeluga
scripts.input_contract: Finite completed OHLC plus finite nonnegative Volume, unique increasing timezone-aware DatetimeIndex of bar opens. Explicit bar duration; optional as_of rejects forming bars. Swing length positive; max_ob supported from0 through500; min strength0 through100; displacement finite including source-permitted zero/negative values.
scripts.calculation_origin_contract: Consume entire fixed supplied history as Pine bar_index0 onward. No rolling last3000 truncation. Exact exported fixtures must pin the first source calculation bar because its indicator declaration uses calc_bars_count=3000; extending and restarting must retain that original history.
scripts.availability_contract: A pivot is observed only after sw_len right bars. Retrospective origin/cross timestamps are metadata; new zones first appear at the completed confirmation bar or later close-breakout bar through available_at. Earlier rows are never backfilled. Current/created snapshots are immutable OrderBlock records.
scripts.volume_contract: Zone high/low remain raw pivot-candle prices. Volume changes only strength/filter and source opacity: ratio uses pivot volume divided by SMA20 at the pivot; missing/nonpositive SMA falls back to ratio1. Raw alpha truncates96-12*ratio toward zero, clamps40..92, strength=100-alpha, hence range8..60. Delayed creation retains the pivot-bar average, not the current average.
scripts.state_contract: Accepted low pivot processed before high pivot. Threshold uses ATR100 on confirmation bar. Earliest crossed bar among the right-side confirmation bars is retained. Retroactive creation and mitigation checks precede active invalidation/retests; delayed close-cross creation follows that pass, so a creation-bar breach can remain active until the next bar. Pending pivots are replaced by new accepted same-side pivots; wicks do not cancel pending state. Crossover compares prior close to prior threshold series value.
scripts.bounds_contract: Remove inclusive price overlaps only for same-side zones. Shared FIFO active-zone capacity spans both sides. Zero capacity permits creation/removal events with no retained zone. B/S retest cooldown starts at bar0, is global per direction, and requires more than5 bars; active zones are visited newest first. Invalidation precedes any retest label.
scripts.port_scope: Raw/accepted pivot confirmations, pending thresholds, retroactive/delayed creations, active/latest zone features, origin/cross/availability metadata, volume strength, B/S retest label events, removal counts and optional immutable full-zone snapshots. Source defines no alertcondition/alert call or execution exits; no trade policy invented.
